rules.title_zh: Codex 插件市场升级残留
rules.what_zh: Codex 升级插件市场时，先把新版本解包到这个临时目录。升级失败后，这些目录不会被自动回收。
rules.what_en: Codex unpacks new plugin marketplace versions into these temporary folders. Failed updates leave these folders behind.
rules.why_zh: 都是升级用的临时副本，正在使用的插件不在这里。最近 1 小时内有改动的目录会自动跳过。
rules.why_en: These are temporary update copies, separate from the plugins in use. Folders changed within the last hour are skipped.
rules.after_zh: 不影响 Codex 使用；下次升级会重新下载。
rules.after_en: Codex keeps working. The next update will download the files again.
rules.fix_hint_zh: 这是 Codex 自身的问题。可以反馈给 Codex：插件市场升级失败时，删除本次在临时目录里创建的升级副本。
rules.fix_hint_en: This is an issue in Codex itself. Report that failed plugin marketplace updates should remove the update copies created in the temporary folder during that attempt.

rules.what_zh: Codex 为不同版本留下的运行时目录，方便切换时不用重新下载。
rules.what_en: Codex keeps runtime folders for different versions so switching versions does not require another download.
rules.why_zh: 旧副本通常可以清，但会保留最新一份，以免正在用的版本被拿走。
rules.why_en: Older copies can usually be cleaned, but the newest copy is kept to avoid removing the version in use.
rules.after_zh: 当前这份还能用。以后换版本时，缺的运行时会再下载。
rules.after_en: The current copy remains available. Missing runtimes will be downloaded when you switch versions.
rules.in_use_en: Can be cleaned after closing Codex

rules.what_zh: Claude 桌面版升级后仍留在本机的旧程序目录，每个版本都占一份空间。
rules.what_en: Old Claude desktop program folders remain after updates, with each version taking up space.
rules.why_zh: 会留下最新一份，并跳过正在运行的版本。超过一天的旧目录一般可以清。
rules.why_en: The newest copy is kept, and versions that are running are skipped. Old folders over a day old can usually be cleaned.
rules.after_zh: 当前安装的版本还能打开。若要回退到更早版本，需要重新安装。
rules.after_en: The installed version still opens. Returning to an earlier version requires reinstalling it.
rules.in_use_en: Can be cleaned after closing Claude

rules.what_zh: Claude 桌面版更新时下载的安装包缓存，方便再次安装同一版本。
rules.what_en: Claude desktop caches installers downloaded during updates so the same version can be installed again.
rules.why_zh: 不是正在运行的程序本身。需要确认后再清，以免你还想重装这一版。
rules.why_en: These are separate from the running program. Confirm before cleaning in case you want to reinstall this version.
rules.after_zh: 已安装的程序还能用。下次更新会重新下载安装包。
rules.after_en: The installed app keeps working. The next update will download its installer again.

rules.title_zh: Claude Code 会话临时目录
rules.what_zh: Claude Code 会话里放下的截图、导出物和工作草稿，会话结束后常常还留着。
rules.what_en: Screenshots, exports and drafts created during Claude Code sessions often remain after the session ends.
rules.why_zh: 三天没再改动的目录多半已经用完，但仍可能有你想留下的材料，所以需要确认。
rules.why_en: Folders unchanged for three days are probably no longer needed, but they may contain material you want to keep. Review them first.
rules.after_zh: 进行中的会话不受影响。若里面还有未另存的材料，将无法再从这里找回。
rules.after_en: Active sessions are unaffected. Any material you have not saved elsewhere cannot be recovered from here.

rules.what_zh: Grok 命令行下载工具或更新包时留下的文件。
rules.what_en: Files left by the Grok CLI when downloading tools or updates.
rules.why_zh: 超过一天的下载件通常已经装完，再清只会让下次重新取一次。
rules.why_en: Downloads over a day old have usually been installed. Cleaning them means downloading them again next time.
rules.after_zh: 已安装的 Grok 还能用。以后更新会重新下载需要的文件。
rules.after_en: The installed Grok keeps working. Future updates will download the files they need.

rules.what_zh: 自动化测试或渲染时新建的一次性浏览器配置，用完后经常没有被删除。
rules.what_en: Disposable browser profiles created for automated tests or rendering often remain after use.
rules.why_zh: 每个目录只服务一次运行。正在被进程用到的会跳过，一小时内刚写过的也会跳过。
rules.why_en: Each folder serves a single run. Profiles in use by a process, or written to within the last hour, are skipped.
rules.after_zh: 不影响日常上网。下次测试会再新建自己的临时配置。
rules.after_en: Everyday browsing is unaffected. The next test will create its own temporary profile.
rules.fix_hint_zh: 在启动无头浏览的项目里，关闭浏览器后删除本次新建的那一个临时目录，只删自己建的，并核对其父目录和名字前缀。
rules.fix_hint_en: In the project that launches the headless browser, close the browser and remove only the temporary folder created by that run. Check its parent folder and name prefix first.
rules.in_use_zh: 测试结束、浏览器关掉后可清
rules.in_use_en: Can be cleaned after tests finish and the browser is closed

rules.what_zh: Claude Code 保存的对话正文，用来续接上次工作和找回改过的内容。
rules.what_en: Conversations saved by Claude Code to resume work and recover earlier changes.
rules.why_zh: 删了就没法接着聊，也难以找回当时的改动。Flick 不会清理这类数据。
rules.why_en: Deleting these loses the conversations and makes earlier changes harder to recover. Flick leaves this data alone.
rules.after_zh: 这里只统计占用，不会进入清理计划。
rules.after_en: Only space usage is counted. This data stays out of the cleanup plan.
rules.retention_zh: Claude Code 默认删除 30 天前的会话
rules.retention_en: Claude Code deletes sessions older than 30 days by default

rules.what_zh: Claude Code 在改文件前留下的快照，用来对照或找回旧内容。
rules.what_en: Snapshots saved by Claude Code before editing files, used to compare or recover earlier content.
rules.why_zh: 这是你的工作痕迹，不是临时缓存。Flick 不会清理这类数据。
rules.why_en: These are records of your work, rather than temporary cache files. Flick leaves this data alone.
rules.after_zh: 这里只统计占用，不会进入清理计划。
rules.after_en: Only space usage is counted. This data stays out of the cleanup plan.

rules.what_zh: Cursor 保存在本机的聊天记录，用来回顾对话和继续未完成的工作。
rules.what_en: Chats saved locally by Cursor to review conversations and continue unfinished work.
rules.why_zh: 清掉就无法从这里找回这些对话。Flick 不会清理这类数据。
rules.why_en: Cleaning these removes the conversations from here. Flick leaves this data alone.
rules.after_zh: 这里只统计占用，不会进入清理计划。
rules.after_en: Only space usage is counted. This data stays out of the cleanup plan.

rules.what_zh: Codex 各配置目录里保存的会话记录。
rules.what_en: Session records saved in Codex profile folders.
rules.why_zh: 这是对话历史，不是升级残留。Flick 不会清理这类数据。
rules.why_en: These are conversation history, separate from update leftovers. Flick leaves this data alone.
rules.after_zh: 这里只统计占用，不会进入清理计划。
rules.after_en: Only space usage is counted. This data stays out of the cleanup plan.

rules.what_zh: Grok 保存在本机的会话记录。
rules.what_en: Session records saved locally by Grok.
rules.why_zh: 清掉就无法从这里续接这些对话。Flick 不会清理这类数据。
rules.why_en: Cleaning these prevents you from resuming the conversations from here. Flick leaves this data alone.
rules.after_zh: 这里只统计占用，不会进入清理计划。
rules.after_en: Only space usage is counted. This data stays out of the cleanup plan.

rules.what_zh: Google Chrome 打开网页时留下的临时图片、脚本和媒体片断。
rules.what_en: Temporary images, scripts and media fragments saved by Google Chrome when opening web pages.
rules.why_zh: 这些只是浏览过程中的临时副本，登录信息和网站自己保存的数据不在这里。
rules.why_en: These are temporary browsing copies. Sign-in information and data saved by websites are separate.
rules.after_zh: 不会退出登录。下次打开网页会重新拉取一部分内容，前几秒可能稍慢。
rules.after_en: You stay signed in. Some page content will be downloaded again, so pages may be slower for the first few seconds.
rules.in_use_en: Can be cleaned after closing Chrome

rules.in_use_en: Can be cleaned after closing Brave

rules.what_zh: Google Chrome 为加快网页脚本和画面显示而保存的编译结果和显卡缓存。
rules.what_en: Compiled scripts and GPU caches saved by Google Chrome to speed up web pages and graphics.
rules.why_zh: 都是加速用的副本，清掉不会改收藏、密码或扩展。正在运行时会自动跳过占用的项。
rules.why_en: These copies improve speed. Cleaning leaves bookmarks, passwords and extensions alone. Items in use are skipped while the browser is running.
rules.after_zh: 不会退出登录。之后几天里，部分页面和动画可能重新编译，会稍慢一会儿。
rules.after_en: You stay signed in. Some pages and animations may briefly run more slowly as they are recompiled over the next few days.
rules.in_use_en: Can be cleaned after closing Chrome

rules.what_zh: Google Chrome 给一些网站留下的离线脚本和后台缓存，方便下次打开更快。
rules.what_en: Offline scripts and background caches saved by Google Chrome to help some websites open faster next time.
rules.why_zh: 不是登录态本身，但个别网站会靠它记住离线内容。需要你确认后再清。
rules.why_en: These are separate from sign-in data, but some websites rely on them for offline content. Review before cleaning.
rules.after_zh: 不会退出登录。依赖离线缓存的网站会重新下载自己的材料。
rules.after_en: You stay signed in. Websites that rely on offline caches will download their content again.
rules.in_use_en: Can be cleaned after closing Chrome

rules.what_zh: Google Chrome 崩溃后留下的报告文件，用来给厂商排查问题。
rules.what_en: Reports left after Google Chrome crashes, used by its developers to troubleshoot problems.
rules.why_zh: 超过一天的报告通常已经用不上，也不含你的登录信息。
rules.why_en: Reports over a day old are usually no longer needed and do not contain your sign-in information.
rules.after_zh: 不影响正常上网。若之后再次崩溃，会生成新的报告。
rules.after_en: Everyday browsing is unaffected. New reports will be created if the browser crashes again.

rules.title_zh: Chrome 登录信息与网站数据
rules.what_zh: Google Chrome 保存的登录状态、网站本地数据和自动填充信息。
rules.what_en: Sign-in state, local website data and autofill information saved by Google Chrome.
rules.why_zh: 清掉之后需要重新登录许多网站，Flick 不会清理这类数据。
rules.why_en: Cleaning this would require signing in to many websites again. Flick leaves this data alone.
rules.after_zh: 这里只统计占用，不会进入清理计划。
rules.after_en: Only space usage is counted. This data stays out of the cleanup plan.

rules.what_zh: Chrome 下载到本机的端侧模型，用来在电脑上做部分智能功能。
rules.what_en: A model downloaded by Chrome to run some AI features on your computer.
rules.why_zh: 直接删除后，Chrome 往往会再下载回来。若要停用，需要先在浏览器设置里关掉相关功能。
rules.why_en: Chrome often downloads it again if you delete it directly. To stop using it, turn off the related feature in browser settings first.
rules.after_zh: Flick 不会在应用内删除它，只提示占用和做法。
rules.after_en: Flick shows its space usage and guidance. It does not delete the model in the app.
rules.advice_zh: Chrome 设置 › 系统 › 关掉“设备端 AI”，Chrome 会自己删掉它。
rules.advice_en: In Chrome Settings > System, turn off on-device AI. Chrome will remove it itself.

rules.what_zh: Firefox 打开网页时留下的临时文件。
rules.what_en: Temporary files saved by Firefox when opening web pages.
rules.why_zh: 不是书签、密码或登录状态。正在运行时会跳过占用的配置。
rules.why_en: Bookmarks, passwords and sign-in data are separate. Profiles in use while Firefox is running are skipped.
rules.after_zh: 不会退出登录。下次打开网页会重新拉取一部分内容。
rules.after_en: You stay signed in. Some page content will be downloaded again next time.
rules.in_use_en: Can be cleaned after closing Firefox

rules.what_zh: 许多桌面应用内嵌的网页引擎留下的缓存目录。
rules.what_en: Cache folders left by the web engines embedded in many desktop apps.
rules.why_zh: 只针对缓存目录名。账号数据和系统联接不在清理范围内，扫描时会跳过联接。
rules.why_en: Only cache folder names are matched. Account data and system junctions are outside the cleanup scope, and junctions are skipped during scanning.
rules.after_zh: 应用还能打开。首次进入部分页面可能稍慢。
rules.after_en: Apps still open. Some pages may load more slowly the first time.
rules.in_use_zh: 关掉对应的程序后可清
rules.in_use_en: Can be cleaned after closing the relevant app

rules.what_zh: 各类桌面应用写下的日志目录，方便厂商或自己排查问题。
rules.what_en: Logs written by desktop apps to help you or their developers troubleshoot problems.
rules.why_zh: 超过一周没再更新的日志多半已经看完。若你正在查某次故障，可以先留着。
rules.why_en: Logs unchanged for over a week are usually no longer needed. Keep them if you are investigating an earlier failure.
rules.after_zh: 应用还能用。以后出问题会再写新的日志。
rules.after_en: Apps keep working. They will write new logs if problems occur.

rules.what_zh: 编辑器和相关工具更新时解包留下的临时目录，装完常常没收拾。
rules.what_en: Temporary folders left when editors and related tools unpack updates, often remaining after installation.
rules.why_zh: 超过一天的解包目录通常已经安装完毕，正在用的程序不在这里。
rules.why_en: Unpacking folders over a day old have usually served their purpose. Programs in use are separate.
rules.after_zh: 已装好的软件还能用。下次更新会再解包一份新的。
rules.after_en: Installed software keeps working. The next update will unpack a new copy.

rules.what_zh: 下载文件夹里超过一周的安装包，装完后常常还躺在那里。
rules.what_en: Installers over a week old in Downloads, often left behind after installation.
rules.why_zh: 可能你还想留着重装，所以默认不勾选，需要你确认。
rules.why_en: You may want to keep them for reinstallation, so they are unchecked by default and need your confirmation.
rules.after_zh: 已安装的软件不受影响。以后若要重装，需要重新下载安装包。
rules.after_en: Installed software is unaffected. Reinstalling later requires downloading the installer again.

rules.what_zh: 不少桌面应用用同一套更新机制，把安装包缓存在 packages 目录。
rules.what_en: Many desktop apps use the same update mechanism, caching installers in a packages folder.
rules.why_zh: 不是正在运行的程序。系统联接会在扫描时跳过。需要确认后再清。
rules.why_en: These are separate from the running program. System junctions are skipped during scanning. Confirm before cleaning.
rules.after_zh: 已安装的应用还能用。下次更新会重新下载安装包。
rules.after_en: Installed apps keep working. The next update will download its installer again.

rules.what_zh: Windows 用来在设备之间共享更新和商店内容的缓存。
rules.what_en: Windows caches updates and Store content to share them between devices.
rules.why_zh: 清理通常需要系统自己的磁盘清理或管理员权限，Flick 只提示占用。
rules.why_en: Cleaning usually requires Windows Disk Cleanup or administrator access. Flick only shows space usage.
rules.after_zh: 可在系统磁盘清理里勾选传递优化文件。应用内不会删除。
rules.after_en: Select Delivery Optimization Files in Windows Disk Cleanup. Flick does not delete them in the app.
rules.advice_zh: 设置 › 系统 › 存储 › 临时文件，勾选“传递优化文件”后删除。
rules.advice_en: In Settings > System > Storage > Temporary files, select Delivery Optimization Files and remove them.

rules.what_zh: Windows 更新已经下载、等待安装或安装后留下的文件。
rules.what_en: Windows Update files waiting to be installed or left behind after installation.
rules.why_zh: 正在更新时不要动。清理通常要系统工具或管理员权限，Flick 只提示占用。
rules.why_en: Leave these alone during an update. Cleaning usually requires system tools or administrator access. Flick only shows space usage.
rules.after_zh: 应用内不会删除。需要时请用系统自带的更新或磁盘清理。
rules.after_en: Flick does not delete these in the app. Use Windows Update or Disk Cleanup when needed.

rules.what_zh: 系统临时目录里超过一周没有再改动、也没被其它规则认领的文件和文件夹。
rules.what_en: Files and folders in the system temporary folder unchanged for over a week and unmatched by other rules.
rules.why_zh: 这些是过期的临时项。刚写过的、正在用的或已被专门规则覆盖的不会算进来。
rules.why_en: These are old temporary items. Recent items, items in use and those covered by specific rules are excluded.
rules.after_zh: 正在运行的程序不受影响。个别安装程序可能下次再解包一次。
rules.after_en: Running programs are unaffected. Some installers may unpack files again next time.

rules.what_zh: 你的用户临时目录里超过一周没有再改动、也没被其它规则认领的内容。
rules.what_en: Items in your temporary folder unchanged for over a week and unmatched by other rules.
rules.why_zh: 过期临时项可以清。被专门规则认走的目录不会重复计算。
rules.why_en: Old temporary items can be cleaned. Folders matched by specific rules are not counted twice.
rules.after_zh: 正在用的程序不受影响。个别软件会在下次启动时重建临时文件。
rules.after_en: Programs in use are unaffected. Some apps will recreate temporary files at their next launch.

rules.what_zh: npm 下载过的软件包缓存，用来加快下次安装。
rules.what_en: Packages cached by npm to speed up future installations.
rules.why_zh: 清掉只会让下次安装重新下载。项目源码和登录配置不在这里。
rules.why_en: Cleaning means downloading packages again next time. Project source code and sign-in settings are separate.
rules.after_zh: 已安装的项目还能运行。下一次安装会重新取包，速度会慢一些。
rules.after_en: Installed projects still run. The next installation will download packages again and take longer.

rules.what_zh: pip 保存的下载和构建缓存。
rules.what_en: Download and build caches saved by pip.
rules.why_zh: 不是虚拟环境本身。清掉后下次安装会重新下载和构建。
rules.why_en: These are separate from virtual environments. The next installation will download and build packages again.
rules.after_zh: 已建好的环境还能用。之后安装同样的包会再花一次时间。
rules.after_en: Existing environments keep working. Installing the same packages later will take more time.

rules.what_zh: Yarn 下载过的软件包缓存。
rules.what_en: Packages downloaded and cached by Yarn.
rules.why_zh: 清掉只会让下次安装重新下载，不会改项目文件。
rules.why_en: Cleaning means downloading packages again next time. Project files are unaffected.
rules.after_zh: 已安装的项目还能运行。下一次安装会慢一些。
rules.after_en: Installed projects still run. The next installation will take longer.

rules.what_zh: uv 的版本化缓存，里面还有锁和可能被多个环境共用的内容。
rules.what_en: The versioned uv cache, including locks and content that may be shared by several environments.
rules.why_zh: 官方不允许直接改这个目录。若要清理，请自己运行 uv 提供的缓存命令。
rules.why_en: uv does not support changing this folder directly. To clean it, run the cache commands provided by uv yourself.
rules.after_zh: Flick 只提示占用，不会在应用内删除。按官方命令清理后，下次会重新填充需要的缓存。
rules.after_en: Flick only shows space usage and does not delete this in the app. After cleaning with the official commands, needed cache content will be recreated.

rules.what_zh: pnpm 给多个项目共用的软件包仓库，项目里的依赖常常以链接指向这里。
rules.what_en: A package store shared by pnpm projects. Project dependencies often link to this store.
rules.why_zh: 直接删除会打断这些链接。若要瘦身，请自己运行 pnpm 的仓库清理命令。
rules.why_en: Deleting it directly breaks those links. To reduce its size, run the pnpm store cleanup command yourself.
rules.after_zh: Flick 只提示占用，不会在应用内删除。按官方命令清理后，未再引用的内容才会被收走。
rules.after_en: Flick only shows space usage and does not delete this in the app. The official cleanup command removes content that is no longer referenced.

rules.what_zh: Cargo 下载过的注册表压缩包和解开的源码缓存。
rules.what_en: Registry archives and unpacked source files cached by Cargo.
rules.why_zh: 不是你的项目源码，也不是已编译的程序。清掉后下次构建会重新取这些包。
rules.why_en: These are separate from your project source and compiled programs. The next build will fetch these packages again.
rules.after_zh: 已经编好的程序还能运行。下一次编译会重新下载需要的包。
rules.after_en: Compiled programs still run. The next build will download the packages it needs.

rules.what_zh: Gradle 为构建下载和保存的依赖缓存，体积常常很大。
rules.what_en: Dependency caches downloaded and saved by Gradle for builds. They can take up considerable space.
rules.why_zh: 清掉后下次构建会重新下载，可能要很久，所以需要确认。
rules.why_en: The next build will download them again, which may take a long time. Review before cleaning.
rules.after_zh: 已安装的开发环境还在。下一次构建会重新取依赖。
rules.after_en: Your installed development environment remains available. The next build will fetch dependencies again.

rules.what_zh: Playwright 下载到本机的测试用浏览器，一份就能占不少空间。
rules.what_en: Test browsers downloaded by Playwright. Each copy can take up considerable space.
rules.why_zh: 不是你日常用的浏览器。清掉后，下次跑相关测试会重新下载。
rules.why_en: These are separate from your everyday browser. Related tests will download them again after cleaning.
rules.after_zh: 日常上网不受影响。再次运行 Playwright 时会重新安装这些浏览器。
rules.after_en: Everyday browsing is unaffected. Running Playwright again will reinstall these browsers.

rules.what_zh: 编译原生 Node 模块时留下的头文件和构建缓存。
rules.what_en: Headers and build caches left when compiling native Node modules.
rules.why_zh: 不是项目源码。清掉后，下次编译同类模块会重新准备这些材料。
rules.why_en: These are separate from project source code. The next compilation of similar modules will prepare these files again.
rules.after_zh: 已经装好的模块还能用。再次从源码编译时会多花一些时间。
rules.after_en: Installed modules keep working. Compiling from source again will take more time.

rules.what_zh: 打包 Electron 应用时下载的运行时和构建缓存。
rules.what_en: Runtimes and build caches downloaded when packaging Electron apps.
rules.why_zh: 不是已经发布的应用。清掉后，下次打包会重新下载这些材料。
rules.why_en: These are separate from published apps. The next packaging run will download these files again.
rules.after_zh: 已经打好的安装包还在。下一次打包会慢一些。
rules.after_en: Existing installers remain available. The next packaging run will take longer.

rules.what_zh: Jest 为加快测试而留下的转换缓存，每个工作区都可能有一份。
rules.what_en: Transform caches created by Jest to speed up tests. Each workspace may have its own copy.
rules.why_zh: 可以重建。正在跑测试时请先停掉，避免写到一半的目录被清走。缓存有时是源码的唯一副本，一周内用过的不清。
rules.why_en: The cache can be rebuilt. Stop tests before cleaning to avoid removing folders being written. It can sometimes be the only copy of source code, so caches used within the last week are kept.
rules.after_zh: 测试还能跑，只是下一次会重新转换，开始会慢一些。
rules.after_en: Tests still run, but the next run will transform files again and take longer to start.
rules.in_use_en: Can be cleaned after tests finish

rules.what_zh: 本机缓存的模型文件，体积往往很大，重新下载也要很久。
rules.what_en: Locally cached model files, often large and slow to download again.
rules.why_zh: 不是临时文件。Flick 只提示占用，不在应用内删除。
rules.why_en: These are not temporary files. Flick only shows space usage and does not delete them in the app.
rules.after_zh: 若你在对应工具里清理，下次使用同一模型会重新下载。
rules.after_en: If you clean them in the relevant tool, using the same model again will require another download.

rules.what_zh: Ollama 下载到本机的模型权重。
rules.what_en: Model weights downloaded locally by Ollama.
rules.why_zh: 重新下载耗时很长。Flick 只提示占用，不在应用内删除。
rules.why_en: Downloading them again takes a long time. Flick only shows space usage and does not delete them in the app.
rules.after_zh: 若你用 Ollama 自己的命令移除模型，下次还要用时需要重新拉取。
rules.after_en: If you remove a model using Ollama commands, you will need to pull it again to use it later.

rules.what_zh: 程序崩溃后留下的转储文件，用来给开发者排查。
rules.what_en: Dump files left by app crashes to help developers troubleshoot problems.
rules.why_zh: 超过一天的转储通常已经用不上，也不包含你的登录信息。
rules.why_en: Dumps over a day old are usually no longer needed and do not contain your sign-in information.
rules.after_zh: 日常使用不受影响。若之后再次崩溃，会生成新的转储。
rules.after_en: Everyday use is unaffected. New dumps will be created if another crash occurs.

rules.what_zh: Windows 为你的账户收集的错误报告，排队或归档后常常还留着。
rules.what_en: Error reports collected by Windows for your account, often left queued or archived.
rules.why_zh: 超过一天的报告多半已经提交或不再需要。
rules.why_en: Reports over a day old have usually been submitted or are no longer needed.
rules.after_zh: 系统还能收集新的错误报告。不影响已安装的软件。
rules.after_en: Windows can still collect new error reports. Installed software is unaffected.

rules.what_zh: Windows 在系统范围内保存的错误报告目录。
rules.what_en: Error report folders saved by Windows for the whole system.
rules.why_zh: 清理往往需要管理员权限，Flick 只提示占用。
rules.why_en: Cleaning often requires administrator access. Flick only shows space usage.
rules.after_zh: 应用内不会删除。可用系统自带的磁盘清理处理。
rules.after_en: Flick does not delete these in the app. Use Windows Disk Cleanup to manage them.

rules.what_zh: 显卡驱动为加快游戏和界面绘制而保存的着色器缓存。
rules.what_en: Shader caches saved by graphics drivers to speed up games and interface rendering.
rules.why_zh: 可以重建。清掉不会改游戏存档或账号。
rules.why_en: These can be rebuilt. Cleaning leaves game saves and accounts alone.
rules.after_zh: 下次打开相关程序时会重新编译一部分画面效果，开始可能稍卡。
rules.after_en: Some effects will be recompiled the next time you open related apps. They may stutter briefly at first.

rules.what_zh: 资源管理器用来记住文件夹图标和缩略图的目录。
rules.what_en: A folder used by File Explorer to remember folder icons and thumbnails.
rules.why_zh: 这个位置还可能夹着其它资源管理器状态。Flick 只提示占用，不在应用内删除。
rules.why_en: This location may also contain other File Explorer state. Flick only shows space usage and does not delete it in the app.
rules.after_zh: 若用系统工具重建缩略图，浏览文件夹时会重新生成预览。
rules.after_en: If you rebuild thumbnails with system tools, previews will be generated again as you browse folders.

rules.what_zh: 项目里按约定放了缓存标记文件的目录，表示这里是可以重建的缓存。
rules.what_en: Project folders containing a standard cache marker file, indicating that the cache can be rebuilt.
rules.why_zh: 标记本身说明作者允许把这里当成缓存。只在你添加的文件夹里查找。
rules.why_en: The marker indicates that the author allows the folder to be treated as a cache. Only folders you add are searched.
rules.after_zh: 项目源码还在。下次构建或运行会重新生成这些缓存。
rules.after_en: Project source code remains available. The next build or run will recreate the caches.

rules.what_zh: Python 及其检查工具在项目里留下的缓存目录。
rules.what_en: Cache folders left in projects by Python and its checking tools.
rules.why_zh: 都可以重新生成。只在你添加的文件夹里按目录名查找。
rules.why_en: These can be regenerated. Only folders you add are searched by folder name.
rules.after_zh: 源码不受影响。下次运行测试或检查时会再写出这些目录。
rules.after_en: Source code is unaffected. The next test or check will recreate these folders.

rules.what_zh: 你添加的文件夹里，看起来像完整浏览器配置的目录，常见于自动化测试。
rules.what_en: Folders in locations you add that look like complete browser profiles, often used for automated tests.
rules.why_zh: 日常使用的个人配置不在这些自选文件夹里。仍需要确认，以免误伤还想留的测试环境。
rules.why_en: Your everyday personal profiles are outside these selected folders. Review before cleaning so you can keep test environments you still need.
rules.after_zh: 日常浏览器不受影响。下次测试会再创建自己的配置。
rules.after_en: Your everyday browser is unaffected. The next test will create its own profile.
rules.in_use_zh: 关掉无头浏览器后可清
rules.in_use_en: Can be cleaned after closing the headless browser

rules.what_zh: 你添加的文件夹里超过一周没再改动的项目依赖目录。
rules.what_en: Project dependency folders in locations you add, unchanged for over a week.
rules.why_zh: 可以重新安装，但下次会花时间。只在你添加的文件夹里查找，默认需要确认。
rules.why_en: These can be reinstalled, but doing so takes time. Only folders you add are searched, and cleaning requires confirmation by default.
rules.after_zh: 项目源码还在。若要继续开发，需要重新安装依赖。
rules.after_en: Project source code remains available. Reinstall dependencies before continuing development.

rules.what_zh: 你添加的文件夹里，Rust 项目编译时生成的构建目录（根下有 Cargo 写的 .rustc_info.json）。
rules.what_en: Build folders generated by Rust projects in locations you add, with a Cargo-generated .rustc_info.json at their root.
rules.why_zh: 只含编译产物，可以完整重建。只在你添加的文件夹里查找。
rules.why_en: These contain build output and can be rebuilt completely. Only folders you add are searched.
rules.after_zh: 项目源码还在。下次编译会重新生成，第一次会慢一些。
rules.after_en: Project source code remains available. The next build will regenerate the output and take longer.

rules.what_zh: 目录里的 .git 是一个小文件而不是文件夹，通常是 git worktree 建出的工作树，也可能是子模块。
rules.what_en: A .git file rather than a folder usually indicates a Git worktree, but may also indicate a submodule.
rules.why_zh: 里面可能有还没提交的改动，Flick 不读文件内容，无法确认，所以只列出、不提供清理。
rules.why_en: There may be uncommitted changes. Flick does not read file contents to check, so it lists these without offering cleanup.
rules.after_zh: 确认不再需要后，在主仓库里用 git worktree remove 删除，主仓库的登记会一并清掉。
rules.after_en: Once you are sure it is no longer needed, run git worktree remove from the main repository to remove it and its registration.

rules.title_zh: 程序或工具自带的依赖
rules.title_en: Dependencies bundled with apps or tools
rules.what_zh: 名字叫 node_modules，但旁边没有像项目的文件，多半是全局安装的命令行工具、桌面程序解包出的文件，或某个程序自带的依赖。
rules.what_en: A node_modules folder without nearby project files is likely a global CLI installation, unpacked desktop app content or dependencies bundled with an app.
rules.why_zh: 删掉可能让对应的工具或程序打不开。Flick 无法确认它属于谁，所以不提供清理，仅供参考。
rules.why_en: Deleting it may stop the tool or app from opening. Flick cannot confirm its owner, so it only shows this for reference and offers no cleanup.
rules.after_zh: 确认是不再用的工具后，用安装它的方式卸载，例如 npm uninstall -g。
rules.after_en: If you no longer need the tool, uninstall it the way it was installed, such as with npm uninstall -g.

rules.what_zh: 看起来像完整的浏览器配置，但路径里没有自动化测试工具的名字，多半是某个桌面程序内嵌浏览器（Chromium、WebView2、CEF）的数据。
rules.what_en: Folders resembling complete browser profiles without automation tool names in their paths. They are likely data for browsers embedded in desktop apps, such as Chromium, WebView2 or CEF.
rules.why_zh: 里面可能有登录状态和程序数据，删掉可能要重新登录或让程序出错，所以不提供清理，仅供参考。
rules.why_en: These may hold sign-in state and app data. Deleting them may require signing in again or cause app errors, so Flick only shows them for reference and offers no cleanup.
rules.after_zh: 要清理，请在对应程序里退出登录或卸载程序。
rules.after_en: To clean these, sign out in the relevant app or uninstall it.

rules.what_zh: 桌面应用自动更新时下载的安装包，安装完成后常留在原处。
rules.what_en: Installers downloaded during automatic desktop app updates, often left after installation.
rules.why_zh: 只清超过一天的更新包残留；正在使用的文件删不掉时会原样留下。
rules.why_en: Only update leftovers over a day old are cleaned. Files that cannot be deleted because they are in use are kept as they are.
rules.after_zh: 应用仍可使用；以后需要这些安装包时，会重新下载。
rules.after_en: Apps keep working. These installers will be downloaded again if needed.

rules.title_zh: 命令行工具旧版本备份
rules.what_zh: 命令行工具自更新后留下的旧程序备份，文件名以 .old 或 .bak 结尾。
rules.what_en: Old program backups left by CLI updates, with names ending in .old or .bak.
rules.why_zh: 只清超过一天、以 .old 或 .bak 结尾的备份，当前程序不在清理范围内；正在使用的备份删不掉时会原样留下。
rules.why_en: Only backups over a day old ending in .old or .bak are cleaned. The current program is excluded, and backups that cannot be deleted because they are in use are kept.
rules.after_zh: 当前程序仍可运行；若要回到旧版本，需要重新安装。
rules.after_en: The current program still runs. Returning to an old version requires reinstalling it.

rules.what_zh: Claude Code 原生安装目录里并排保留的旧版本程序。
rules.what_en: Older program versions kept alongside each other in the native Claude Code installation folder.
rules.why_zh: 保留最新的一个版本，只清超过一天的旧版本。
rules.why_en: The newest version is kept. Only older versions over a day old are cleaned.
rules.after_zh: 当前版本仍可使用；被清掉的旧版本需要重新安装才能使用。
rules.after_en: The current version keeps working. Removed versions must be reinstalled to use them again.

rules.in_use_en: Can be cleaned after closing Claude

rules.what_zh: Cursor 在运行时生成的编译缓存，帮助后续启动更快。
rules.what_en: Compile caches generated by Cursor at runtime to speed up later launches.
rules.why_zh: 只清一周以前的缓存；这些内容可以由程序重新生成。
rules.why_en: Only caches over a week old are cleaned. The app can regenerate this content.
rules.after_zh: 下次启动会重新生成缓存，首次启动可能稍慢。
rules.after_en: The cache will be regenerated at the next launch, which may take a little longer.

rules.what_zh: QoderWork 按工作区留下的临时目录。
rules.what_en: Temporary folders left by QoderWork for individual workspaces.
rules.why_zh: 无法确定这些临时文件是否还要使用，需要你确认；只清超过一天的目录。
rules.why_en: Flick cannot tell whether these files are still needed, so review them first. Only folders over a day old are cleaned.
